topic_thesis: Zero-Cost EMI is a legal marketing trap where banks charge mandatory 18% GST on hidden interest, instantly turning your 'free' offer into an expensive credit leak.
strategic_angle: Expose how e-commerce sites and banks artificially split your invoice into a discounted principal and phantom interest, forcing you to pay 18% GST on that interest alongside an unadvertised upfront processing fee.
key_statistic: 18% GST on interest + ₹299 hidden processing fee
target_emotion: Shock and immediate urge to check personal accounts
pinned_comment_text: Did you buy your phone on 'Zero Cost EMI'? Check your statement for 'GST on EMI Interest'! Comment 'CALCULATE' for our free breakdown tool to see how much you overpaid. 💬👇
tamil_adaptation_directive: Target middle-class shoppers in Tamil Nadu buying electronics. Use relatable Tanglish phrases like 'Zero Cost EMI Nambi Aapa Vangathaenga' and expose how a ₹60,000 phone silently drains extra cash through hidden GST and processing fees.
